prompt: Summarize the excerpt from 'dmoi3-tablet' (chunk 73.2) about mathematics: The set A × B contains all pairs with the first half of the pair being some a i ∈ A and the second being one of the b j
true_answer: The set A × B contains all pairs with the first half of the pair being some a i ∈ A and the second being one of the b j ∈ B . In other words: A × B | {( a 1 , b 1 ) , ( a 1 , b 2 ) , ( a 1 , b 3 ) ,... ( a 1 , b n ) , ( a 2 , b 1 ) , ( a 2 , b 2 ) , ( a 2 , b 3 ) ,..., ( a 2 , b n ) , ( a 3 , b 1 ) , ( a 3 , b 2 ) , ( a 3 , b 3 ) ,..., ( a 3 , b n ) , ... ( a m , b 1 ) , ( a m , b 2 ) , ( a m , b 3 ) ,..., ( a m , b n )} . Notice what we have done here: we made m rows of n pairs, for a total of m · n pairs. Each row above is really { a i }× B for some a i ∈ A .
